name: Antipsychotic
summary: Antipsychotic is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Antipsychotic drugs such as haloperidol and chlorpromazine tend to block dopamine D2 receptors in the dopaminergic pathways of the brain. This means that dopamine released in these pathways has less effect. Excess release of dopamine in the mesolimbic pathway has been linked to psychotic experiences.

uses.text: Antipsychotics, previously known as neuroleptics and major tranquilizers, are a class of psychotropic medication primarily used to manage psychosis (including delusions, hallucinations, paranoia or disordered thought), principally in schizophrenia but also in a range of other psychotic disorders. Together with mood stabilizers, they are also a mainstay in the treatment of bipolar disorder.
uses.recreational: Certain second-generation antipsychotics are misused or abused for their sedative, tranquilizing, and (paradoxically) "hallucinogenic" effects. The most commonly implicated second-generation antipsychotic is quetiapine. In case reports, quetiapine has been abused in doses taken by mouth (which is how the drug is available from the manufacturer), but also crushed and insufflated or mixed with water for injection into a vein.

zhOther: 安定藥, 抗精神病藥物, 精神抑制藥物
zhHansOther: 安定药, 抗精神病药物, 精神抑制药物
summaryZh: 抗精神病藥是精神活性藥物的一種，可在不影響意識清醒的條件下，控制興奮、躁動、幻覺及妄想等症狀。主要用於治療思覺失調症，此類藥物也用於應對和治療一些其他精神障礙，而抗精神病藥和情緒穩定劑的共同使用，也對雙相障礙的治療有很大助益。
summaryZhHans: 抗精神病药是精神活性药物的一种，可在不影响意识清醒的条件下，控制兴奋、躁动、幻觉及妄想等症状。主要用于治疗精神分裂症，此类药物也用于应对和治疗一些其他精神障碍，而抗精神病药和心境稳定剂的共同使用，也对双相障碍的治疗有很大助益。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include sedation, restlessness, stiffness, tremor, weight gain and raised prolactin. Long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, lasting involuntary movements. Neuroleptic malignant syndrome, with fever, rigidity and confusion, is rare but a medical emergency.
sideEffects.zh: 常見的反應包括鎮靜、坐立不安、肌肉僵硬、顫抖、體重增加與泌乳素升高。長期使用可能造成遲發性運動障礙，即持續的不自主動作。抗精神病藥惡性症候群雖然罕見，但出現發燒、肌肉僵硬與混亂時屬於醫療緊急狀況。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见的反应包括镇静、坐立不安、肌肉僵硬、颤抖、体重增加与泌乳素升高。长期使用可能造成迟发性运动障碍，即持续的不自主动作。抗精神病药恶性症候群虽然罕见，但出现发烧、肌肉僵硬与混乱时属于医疗紧急状况。

fact.en: The first antipsychotic, chlorpromazine, started as an antihistamine that a French surgeon noticed made patients calm and detached before surgery. It reached psychiatry in 1952 and changed the field completely.
fact.zh: 第一種抗精神病藥氯普麻最初是抗組織胺藥，一位法國外科醫師注意到它能讓病人在手術前變得平靜而超然。它於 1952 年進入精神醫學領域，徹底改變了這個學科。
fact.zhHans: 第一种抗精神病药氯普麻最初是抗组织胺药，一位法国外科医师注意到它能让病人在手术前变得平静而超然。它于 1952 年进入精神医学领域，彻底改变了这个学科。
